thread:
maya: Quick postmortem note: enabling strict fncall schema validation plus coalescing on the canary caused a spike in schema rejects and doubled fallbacks to the degenerate model. Suspect coalescer merged variant payloads and dropped required fields.
liam: Oof. Which flags changed? Coalescer debounce + strict validator together is risky.
sasha: We set routing.debounce_ms=200 and coalescer.enabled=true. Telemetry shows most rejects as `missing_required_field`.
kevin: That matches: coalescer merges similar requests and can lose per-request optional fields. Options: reduce debounce, soft-validate, or have coalescer preserve per-request snapshots.
anne: For rollout safety, don't flip both flags at once. Rollback coalescing now and run debounce-only.
liam: Also billing attribution is broken: fallbacks are still attributed to the primary model in cost dashboards. We need routing tags.
sasha: Proposal: add `invoke_path`, `fallback_reason`, and `route_coalesced` tags to fncall telemetry. Also emit a `validation.sample_id` instead of request body.
maya: Example: {"metric":"fncall.invoke","tags":["model=gpt-x","invoke_path=coalescer->validator->serve","fallback_reason=schema_mismatch","route_coalesced=true"],"sample_id":"smp_01"} 
kevin: Implementation plan: 1) rollback coalescer on canary; 2) split flags into routing.debounce_ms and validator.strict_mode; 3) add telemetry tags + sample_id; 4) dashboards and runbook updates; 5) add coalescer.preserve_snapshots behind flag.
sasha: Dashboard needs: reject_count by fallback_reason, debounce_hit_rate, latency hist with fallback overlay, cost-by-invoke_path. Keep payloads out of telemetry; use hashed ids for correlation.
liam: I'll own telemetry PR and server-side sampling for validation errors.
maya: I'll coordinate the rollout and flags. Don't enable strict validator until we have routing attribution visible.
kevin: I'll add preserve_snapshots option to coalescer and measure perf impact.
anne: Deploy-bot, schedule rollback of coalescer on prod-canary?
deploy-bot: scheduled rollback of flag `coalescer.enabled` -> false on prod-canary at 2024-11-12T15:12:00Z. CI: green.
maya: Assignments: maya (rollout), liam (telemetry), sasha (dashboards/runbook), kevin (coalescer). Follow up with PR links here. :thumbsup:
